scope: Original-public baseline only: eight spatial and five known-ID trials / 26 first+reuse operations. Candidate/GeoParquet remote comparisons and final recommendation pending.

audit_summary.audit_scope: Read-only immutable receipt/hash/phase/source-equality assertions; no new source reads or full-global authentication.

spatial.code_binding_limit: measured record_probe script hash matches observed source; execution binds commit8b2fac6d928c493187a97928c06b4749b6f50f1f; imported reader/build hashes are observed now, not retroactive per-trial measurements; old reader-source-bindings.json documents local trial code, not remote code

policy.performance_context: all uploads stopped after second TLS failure; root reports serial performance/no concurrent uploads or other measurements; aggregate only, no new traffic
policy.transport: actual instrumented HTTP request counts and returned body bytes; no headers/TLS overhead or provider-side costs; raw request logs kept external and omitted
policy.opening: first result/first transport includes Access opening exactly once; reuse excludes opening; lazy graph footer opening can appear in first discovery; not all startup necessarily occurs in Access constructor
policy.cache: same-reader repeat retains head/tail, native metadata and allowed buffers; no application selected-batch cache; CDN/network/cache state unknown; no cold-cache or provider-general conclusion
policy.projection: small/medium attributes+WKB with explicit decode; elongated/source-boundary/large_amazon attrs-only, no WKB requested/decoded
policy.local_comparison: matching original IPC full-fidelity local groups authenticate IDs and exact projected record-stream hashes, not timing; local workload file hash differs from remote extended file, so selection/hash equality checked directly
policy.source_validation: exact semantic and Arrow-stream equality per selected projected record, outside timers; not independent full-global artifact validation
policy.memory: process lifetime RSS includes interpreter, retained native readers and independent source validation; Arrow materialization/read-ahead/range buffers distinct, not process caps; do not label RSS query-only or add overlapping counters
policy.elapsed: open+discovery+fetch+decode, excludes imports/validation/hashing/JSON; one fresh process per workload, one same-reader reuse; no confidence interval or universal remote performance claim
policy.post_measurement: all8 original spatial trials completed in quiet period; resumable publication may resume afterward; no new performance activity until root authorizes quiet after candidate+GeoParquet publication
